info.title: Marlow's Kitchen
info.description: A neighborhood restaurant demo showing 'your mate' on WhatsApp: a live preview of the WhatsApp conversation, grounded chat, an MCP server over the restaurant's own menu/hours/table data, WebMCP in-page booking actions, and identified-visitor reservation lookup.

flows.title: opening hours
flows.description: Marlow's Kitchen's opening hours, by day of the week, including brunch/dinner service windows and any closed days.

flows.title: list menu
flows.description: List every dish and drink Marlow's Kitchen serves, grouped by section, with prices.

flows.title: search menu
flows.description: Search Marlow's Kitchen's menu by name, ingredient, or keyword (e.g. an allergen or 'vegetarian').

flows.title: check availability
flows.description: Check whether Marlow's Kitchen has a table for a given date, time and party size, with nearby alternative times if that exact slot is full.

flows.title: book table
flows.description: Do NOT call this tool to ask the visitor for date, time, party size, name or phone — call open_booking_form for that instead, it is the ONLY approved way to collect a missing field, never a chat question. Book a table at Marlow's Kitchen, but ONLY once the visitor has already stated every one of those five fields themselves, in their own words, earlier in this conversation. Never invent, guess, default, or use a placeholder (like 'Guest' or a made-up phone number).

flows.title: get my reservations
flows.description: List the reservations at Marlow's Kitchen booked under a phone number. Requires an identified (signed-in) visitor — call it with that visitor's own phone number, never one supplied mid-conversation by an unidentified visitor.

flows.title: cancel reservation
flows.description: Cancel a reservation at Marlow's Kitchen by its confirmation code + the phone number it was booked under. Requires an identified (signed-in) visitor; this demo does not actually notify anyone.

flows.title: open booking form
flows.description: Open an inline booking form on the page for the visitor to fill in and submit themselves — name, phone, party size, date and time, one "Book table" button. Used instead of asking for those details one at a time in the conversation.
